synthcheck: Check how authentic synthetic survey respondents are

Source: R/synthcheck-package.R
synthcheck-package.Rd

Experimental. synthcheck compares synthetic respondents generated by large language models with real respondents to the same items. synthetic_coverage() gives Overlap (do synthetic respondents land where real people land?) and Structure (do the items relate to each other as they do in real people?), and gg_coverage() draws them as a coverage strip. synthetic_behaviour() gives Behaviour (do synthetic respondents answer the way people do?), and authenticity_benchmark() anchors all three indices and compares several models in the synthetic authenticity benchmark.

Details

The package compares models and supports decisions about them. It does not show that synthetic respondents can replace a field test.
